content.text: The insurance provisions fully match our preferred position, so no redline is needed.

input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18.1 requires Vendor, at its own expense for the term plus one year, to carry CGL of USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, E&O of USD 2M and cyber/privacy liability of USD 5M — meeting or exceeding every element of the preferred position (and adding employer's liability of USD 1M). Section 18.2 supplies certificates of insurance on request, reputable-insurer and primary-coverage requirements, cancellation notice, and confirms insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities. All obligations run against the Vendor and benefit us, so no redline is warranted.
